modelNotes: Threes Board 1.0 uses season threes, last 5 threes, last 10 threes, three point attempts, attempt trend, expected minutes, minutes confidence, and usage.
Threes Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent three rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Wembanyama (back) is questionable for Monday's game against the Kings, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.
injury.detail: Wembanyama is dealing with lower-back tightness, leaving his status for Monday's road tilt up in the air. If he's unable to play, Luke Kornet would likely replace Wembanyama in the starting lineup, while Carter Bryant, Keldon Johnson and rookie Tarris Reed Jr. could all see a bump in minutes off the Spurs' bench.

injury.shortComment: Miller is probable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies due to a right knee contusion.
injury.detail: Miller is dealing with a right knee bone bruise, but he is expected to suit up Monday. In three games since returning from a groin injury, Miller has averaged 17.3 points, 4.0 rebounds and 3.7 assists in 29.7 minutes per contest.

injury.shortComment: Murphy (knees) is listed as probable for Monday's game against the Suns.
injury.detail: Murphy has missed seven of New Orleans' past eight games due to bilateral patellar tendinopathy, though he's expected to suit up Monday. The 26-year-old swingman logged 29 minutes off the bench in Friday's loss to the Thunder, marking his return after a six-game stint on the inactive list. He could remain restricted if he's cleared to play Monday.

injury.shortComment: Brown (hamstring) is listed as probable for Monday's game versus Portland.
injury.detail: Brown has a left hamstring strain, though it appears he will suit up after missing only two games. It's unclear if he will see limited action in his first game back from the brief layoff. However, Brown's return would mean Kentavious Caldwell-Pope would revert to a reserve role.

injury.shortComment: Wade (hamstring) is listed as probable for Monday's game against Portland.
injury.detail: Wade is expected to return from a two-game absence due to a left hamstring injury. His return would leave fewer minutes available for guys like Jabari Walker and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope.

injury.shortComment: Fox is questionable for Monday's game against the Kings due to a right shin contusion, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.
injury.detail: Fox could miss Monday's game due to a shin injury he likely picked up during Saturday's game against the Pelicans. With Dylan Harper (hip) out and Jordan McLaughlin (shoulder) questionable, the Spurs could be thin at the lead guard position, leaving more ball-handling responsibilities for Stephon Castle.

injury.shortComment: Williamson (thigh) is probable for Monday's game against Phoenix.
injury.detail: Williamson sat out Saturday's 114-91 loss to San Antonio due to a left thigh contusion, but it sounds like he's trending in the right direction for Monday. His return would likely shift Derik Queen back to the bench.

injury.shortComment: Murray-Boyles (concussion) is listed as probable for Monday's game against Milwaukee, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
injury.detail: Murray-Boyles exited Wednesday's game versus the Wizards and didn't suit up for Friday's 105-102 win over the Pistons. It appears a one-game absence will be all that is needed for the 21-year-old, though it's unclear if he will reclaim his spot in the starting lineup over Allen Graves.

injury.shortComment: Dunn (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Pelicans.
injury.detail: Dunn exited Friday's win over Utah early due to right quad soreness, and despite practicing in full Sunday, he's still questionable to suit up versus New Orleans.

injury.shortComment: McLaughlin (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Kings.
injury.detail: McLaughlin may miss his seventh game of the year. With De'Aaron Fox (shin) also questionable and Dylan Harper (hip) already sidelined, McLaughlin would be in line to receive extra minutes if he manages to suit up. However, if he's not available versus Sacramento, David Jones Garcia could see significantly more work than usual.
